# The reply fails after the credit. The saga stops at the reply: the case goes to the exception queue with the reason code system-failure, which
# goes to the team IT, and the case run fails. The engine then runs the undo of the credit with the key of the credit.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec obeereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

# The credit was written, then undone under the same key. The mail agent failed, so no mail went out.
grep -count=1 '^credit-' writes.log
grep -count=1 '^uncredit-' writes.log
! exists mail.out
exec sh same-key.sh

# The reply was not recorded as sent, so a later run sends it.
! exists home/.desk/sent.tsv

exec obeereal status
stdout 'shift-1-r1\tdone'
stdout 'desk-2-r1\tfailed'

-- same-key.sh --
credit=$(sed -n 's/^credit-//p' writes.log)
undo=$(sed -n 's/^uncredit-//p' writes.log)
[ -n "$credit" ] && [ "$credit" = "$undo" ]
-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=@WORK@/home/.desk/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.desk/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt

Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/mail/cur/keep --
-- home/.desk/chat/keep --

Subject: Refund BK-123456

Thanks, Ann Smith. Please refund 80 for BK-123456.

{"eligible":true}
